frase_gancho.texto: The vivid color of Teotihuacán, its painted paradise, and the round houses.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Leaving by the northern and eastern side of the archaeological zone, a circuit opens up that is devoted to color and to outsiders. It begins at the Museum of Teotihuacán Murals “Beatriz de la Fuente,” next to Gate 3, where the most delicate frescoes of the metropolis are safeguarded. It continues five hundred meters behind the Pyramid of the Sun at the Tepantitla compound, famous for the Tlalocan mural and the ball game, and it ends at the neighboring Merchants’ Quarter, where traders from the Gulf Coast and the Maya area lived in unusual circular houses.
